output.tagline_observed: Easy to use and privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative

voice.sentence_style: Short declaratives in first-person plural, plain language, no jargon, occasional dry wit
evidence_quotes: Most analytics tools are black boxes.
We have never spent a cent on advertising, affiliates or paid endorsements.
Plausible grows because people recommend it when they have no reason to other than that it works.

value_props: No cookies, no personal data, no cookie consent banner required
Lightweight script — 54 times smaller than Google Analytics
Fully open source and auditable under AGPLv3
Made and hosted in the EU — data never leaves EU servers

Check your site traffic and get the essential insights on one page in one minute.
We are self-funded and profitable, with no outside investors and no plans to sell.
Plausible grows because people recommend it when they have no reason to other than that it works.
proof_points_observed: Script is 54 times smaller than Google Analytics
Crossed $1 million in annual recurring revenue in 2022
Customers include Hugging Face, Basecamp, Ghost, MongoDB, Python Software Foundation, Harvard University

typography.evidence: Scrape returned markdown without HTML or CSS; no font-family declarations or font CDN links were observable

output.audience_language: Talks directly to site owners and developers as peers who are frustrated with Google Analytics complexity and want honest, no-nonsense answers about their traffic.

do: Lead with what the product does NOT do (no cookies, no personal data) as a feature
Use plain, specific language — name the problem before the solution
Cite real numbers and named customers when making claims
Acknowledge limitations honestly (e.g. 'Plausible is not the right tool for every analytics use case')
Frame open source as accountability, not just a feature
dont: Use hype words or superlatives not grounded in evidence
Imply surveillance or data brokerage is acceptable
Use passive voice or corporate mission-statement padding
Pretend to be a large company — the bootstrapped, small-team identity is a trust signal

confidence.notes: Colors not observable — scrape returned markdown without HTML/CSS styling, so no hex or rgb values could be extracted. Typography not observable for the same reason. Pricing page returned 404 so pricing details come from homepage only. Blog was scraped as an article index, not individual posts, so blog voice is inferred from titles and descriptions rather than full article text.
